digest.component_or_area: completion-verifier context management and close gate
propositions: Completion verification close gate fails without verdict due to runaway duplicate tool-call loops, request-budget exhaustion, and context-bound refusals (e.g. c9f7: 121,147 chars exceeds 100,000-char bound)

Recovery path fans out one isolated LLM run per criterion (22 criteria × 20-request budget = 440 worst-case requests with ~2.67M re-sent context chars), causing resource waste and verdict-less failures
A run with banked criterion verdicts that dies in a typed failure (budget exhaustion, runaway loop, or token exhaustion) must end in full-coverage verdict instead of verdict-less error
Duplicate read-only tool calls within one agentic run must be memoized and nudged instead of re-executed, preserving runaway actuator behavior
